what_this_is: Organisations with which PlotNua holds an ACTIVE commercial arrangement (referral, commission or paid placement), as opaque keys: sha256(Atlas organisation name)[:12], the same key the price-page extract uses. Read by atlas-tools/check-commercial-disclosure.py, which refuses a build while any page that says PlotNua has no commercial arrangement with the suppliers it describes includes one of these organisations. No names are stored.
source: Atlas Partners table (tblXlzvJMDu67Mym2), read 6 November 2026: Partnership Status = Active.
maintenance: When a Partners record becomes Active, add its organisation's key here in the same change. Records that are Negotiating, Contacted or Paused are not arrangements and are not listed.
